import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**What I did**

- Read all five registered reports through audited artifact reads (cdx, cld, grk, mus, gem — one per expected suffix, matched by wait_name and label).
- Verified every disputed mechanism myself against bob-cli source, the live config, and read-only vault reads: `post_stages` staging is real and live (`[periods]`, Morning review stays unstaged/last), the ★ highlight is literally `entries[first].highlight = true`, gcal sync puts `## Events` immediately above `## Pomodoros` (so an `## Aim` above it is safe), the stale `≤3 themes` clause is still in `gtd_daily.md:13`, and `plan.max_links` is 13.
- Created `202611/daily_aim_design/`, moved the cdx and grk reports (plus grk's six diagram assets, so its image links keep working) with `git mv`, materialized cld/mus/gem from their durable snapshots, and wrote `daily_aim_design__final.md`.
- Registered the final report as `research:202611/daily_aim_design/daily_aim_design__final.md` (ref `file:explicit:013e3eaa17b825b740dac5ca`) for the linker.

**The consolidated recommendation**

Add the daily layer as a **one-line, user-owned `## Aim`** in the daily note — `<state true by tonight> → [[task]] · I#` — not a "daily commitments" list. Four of five researchers converged on this shape; "commitments" collides with the walk's "Commitments done", and the vault's own 2024 `## Goals` history (4.7 lines/day, 28% done, 56% carried, abandoned) rules out a multi-item cap. Cap is one, soft, empty valid; Bryan-only authorship; no task-state effects, no carry-forward, no daily Review; marked next morning with ✓/◐/✗. The ritual change is an edit to the existing Morning review clause (replacing the stale theme-cap wording and adding gem's carryover triage), with cld's dedicated staged `#post` row as the measured fallback if the clause gets skipped. Zero-code trial through 2026-11-30 judged alongside the week-old Intentions practice; week-brief integration only if it passes. Key conflict resolutions (gem's ledger-only ★ fix demoted to Phase 2, mus's ≤3/PRE-row outvoted, the cld-vs-gem walk-ordering "conflict" shown to be no conflict) are documented in a dedicated disagreements section of the report.
